verdict.rationale: Svelte ships an official `sv` CLI. First-party docs cover `npx sv create` for scaffolding, `sv add` for adding features to existing projects, `npx sv check` for code checking, and creating a SvelteKit project from a playground URL. The CLI docs are also published in an LLM-consumable llms.txt format. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-specific CLI functionality (e.g., agent-oriented commands or setting up the MCP server via the CLI), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI in AI-driven workflows.
